Cora asked if loading bay is free in the evening. Vik asked if loading bay is free in the afternoon. Teo and Ada prefer garden studio for reviews. Opal asked if print room is free in the morning. User needs to send Esme, Mira, Opal, and Vik notes from morning meeting. Assistant offered to draft a note to Greta. Vik is involved. Check with Kira before morning meeting.
